name: Form Kernel Dispatch
implementation_notes: Mirrors FormSolidWasteDisposalView.vue's structural pattern (breadcrumb + hamburger header, sectioned form body, dirty-tracking Back confirm, Pause/Clear/Simpan footer actions) but WITHOUT the grid/N-column/time-slot-uniqueness concept — Log Kejadian is a free event log, rows added manually via 'Tambah baris' with no upper bound and no shared checkbox-column grid

Save/Simpan button is `type="button"` with a direct `@click="onSimpan"` handler (NOT `type="submit"` relying on the enclosing `<form>`'s @submit.prevent) — mirrors FormSolidWasteDisposalView.vue's exact convention; jsdom (the Vitest test environment) does not implement the native submit-button-triggers-form-submission behavior, so a submit-button-based approach would silently never invoke the handler under test

Net Weight (MT) computed client-side (gross_weight_mt - tare_weight_mt) via rowNetWeight()/buildDetailPayload(), recomputed immediately before every save call — same 'computed then persisted' pattern as SolidWasteDisposalDetailFormRow

Hapus baris follows the queue-for-deletion pattern (a row with an existing id is queued in pendingDeletionIds, only actually DELETEd by the repo on the next Simpan/Pause call) — consistent with Form Solid Waste Disposal/Form Cages Track
FormField ids given explicitly (id="kernel_dispatch_id", id="date") rather than relying on FormField's auto-derived label-slug id, for stable, predictable test selectors

Remarks/Gate Status rendered as a <select> (Released/Not Released/blank) rather than free text, per entity-catalog's enum(released, not_released) — the only detail field that is an enum rather than free text/number, mirrored from KernelDispatchDetail.remarks_gate_status

known_issues.description: Browser/E2E test not generated for this pass — component-level (Vitest) coverage exercises save/pause/clear/back flows instead.
Unit test coverage % not measured — no Xdebug/PCOV in this environment.
